items.title: QuadRF can spot drones and see WiFi through my wall
items.raw_content: The QuadRF (pictured above) a phased-array radio built around a Raspberry Pi 5 and an FPGA board with picosecond-level timing. It does advanced signal processing and beamforming. It can see WiFi through walls and track drones in flight. If the open source community can come up with something like this, just imagine what governments are capable of. When you plug a computer into a network, tools like Wireshark can show all the hidden traffic you might not even know is there. WiFi packets are the same, but those travel through the air, allowing snooping without physical access.
items.title_zh: QuadRF 能探测无人机，还能隔墙看见 WiFi
items.summary: A write-up describes QuadRF, a phased-array radio built around a Raspberry Pi 5 and an FPGA board with picosecond-level timing, which can see WiFi through walls and track drones in flight.

items.title: Why write code in 2026
items.raw_content: It’s our job to build the software factory - not just the software. Software engineers maintain the assembly line allowing anyone to prompt for a change and ship immediately. We set up the infrastructure that makes agents successful. We act proactively through prompts (skills, AGENTS.md, knowledge bases etc). We protect software reactively through automated evaluation (tests, linting, type systems, evals, other AI, etc).
items.title_zh: 2026 年，为什么还要写代码
items.summary: The author argues that engineers' job is now to build the software factory itself — the prompts, knowledge bases and automated evaluation that let agents ship changes safely.

items.title: The Economics of AI Decoding Chips: Rebalancing Compute, Capacity, and Bandwidth for Efficient LLM Inference
items.title_zh: AI 解码芯片的经济学：为高效 LLM 推理重新平衡算力、容量与带宽
items.summary: The paper argues that mainstream GPUs are built compute-heavy and capacity-light while LLM decoding is memory-bound, and formalizes the inefficiency with two per-chip constants, the roofline ridge point F/B and the compute bundled per GB of memory F/S. It then describes a rebalanced decode-accelerator design point, exemplified by the Skymizer HTX-301 using commodity DDR5, and compares its acquisition cost and throughput against multi-GPU nodes serving DeepSeek-R1 671B.

items.title: SafeGuard: A Lightweight Client-Server Architecture for Real-Time Endpoint Threat Detection and Response
items.title_zh: SafeGuard：面向实时终端威胁检测与响应的轻量级客户端-服务器架构
items.summary: SafeGuard is a three-tier client-server system for endpoint monitoring and response, combining a Flutter and Kotlin Android agent, a Node.js server that authenticates devices, and an administrative dashboard for live monitoring and remote actions, with signature-based threat detection and WSS, JWT and HMAC-protected communication. In a simulated deployment of 50 concurrent endpoints, average command-dispatch latency was about 1.5 seconds and stayed below 2 seconds under load.

items.title: A Symbolic Neural CPU for Quantization-Simulated Writeback and Interpretable Program Execution
items.title_zh: 一种用于量化模拟回写与可解释程序执行的符号神经 CPU
items.summary: The paper introduces a trace-supervised symbolic neural CPU that combines recurrent control, an explicit operation router over a differentiable ALU bank, destination-masked register writeback, full trajectory supervision and matched fixed-point replay, exposing the selected operation, registers and memory signals at each step. On the principal 16-wide benchmark the non-quantized executor reproduces reference execution exactly, and the 8-bit quantization-simulated executor preserves the symbolic operation path through 1,000-instruction programs.

items.title: MLPs are Hebbians: Constructing Efficient Fact-Storing MLPs for Transformers
items.title_zh: MLP 即 Hebbian：为 Transformer 构建高效事实存储 MLP
items.summary: The paper gives a closed-form, Transformer-compatible construction of fact-storing MLPs and analyzes their decoding margin, showing information-theoretically optimal storage scaling for isotropic embeddings and the same scaling for arbitrary key and value embeddings up to geometry-dependent penalty factors. The construction is reported to need 10 to 104 times fewer parameters at matched fact count than prior constructions, and swapping such MLPs into a Transformer is shown to enable modular fact editing.

items.title: FlashTrie: A GPU-Accelerated Constrained Beam Search for Generative Retrieval
items.title_zh: FlashTrie：面向生成式检索的 GPU 加速约束束搜索
items.summary: FlashTrie moves constrained beam search for generative retrieval onto GPUs with an integer-aware succinct trie layout that bit-compresses the index into high-bandwidth memory and a cooperative CUDA kernel that performs beam expansion, validation and pruning on-device. On a library of 800M keywords with beam widths up to 1,000, it is reported to reduce trie-search latency below 3 ms with up to 24x speedup over a multithreaded CPU baseline, and an online A/B test reports a 0.71% revenue lift.

items.title: FindMyText: Robust, Scalable Detection of Text Containment in Large Web-Crawled Corpora
items.title_zh: FindMyText：在大规模网页抓取语料中稳健且可扩展地检测文本包含关系
items.summary: FindMyText is an open-source Python package that extends document fingerprinting with an explicit mechanism for capturing chains of matching fingerprints, allowing more reliable detection of near-verbatim copies of a text within a corpus. It uses distributed disk-based indexing to scale to large web-crawled datasets and is reported to outperform alternative approaches on ArXiv, Wikipedia and generic web content benchmarks.
